title: PetSafe ScoopFree Crystal Pro Legacy Self-Cleaning Litter Box, Front-Entry
say: Customers find the litter box easy to use and appreciate its quick setup process. However, the quality and value for money receive mixed reviews, with some finding it wonderful while others consider it junk and not worth the cost. The odor control receives mixed feedback, with some saying it eliminates smells while others report horrendous odors. Moreover, customers report significant issues with poop management, noting that poop gets caught in the rake and gets everywhere. Additionally, durability is a concern as the crystals only last about two weeks, and the rake mechanism frequently gets stuck.
